title: USDA Food and Nutrition Administration: SNAP, WIC and child nutrition program data, SNAP State Options Report and SNAP State Activity Reports
agency: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Food and Nutrition Administration (formerly Food and Nutrition Service)
keywords: child and adult care food program
questions: which states use broad-based categorical eligibility for SNAP
which states have an ABAWD time limit waiver
the SNAP policy options a state has chosen, compared with another state
SNAP administrative costs by state and the federal share
SNAP participation, issuance and average benefit by state for a fiscal year
SNAP fraud investigations, disqualifications and recipient claims by state
SNAP persons, households and benefits by state for the latest month or each month since FY 2020
WIC participation by state, tribal organization or category (women, infants, children) and WIC food costs
school lunch and breakfast participation, meals served and cash payments by state
national trends in SNAP, WIC, school meals, summer meals and CACFP since 1969

manual.how: Open each link in manual_download/INSTRUCTIONS.md in a browser and save the file under the name shown (the PDFs, Excel files and the SNAP zip download; a dashboard .csv link downloads a small CSV), then upload them. Without the links: Program Data Excel tables at https://www.fna.usda.gov/pd/supplemental-nutrition-assistance-program-snap, https://www.fna.usda.gov/pd/wic-program and https://www.fna.usda.gov/pd/child-nutrition-tables; the State Options Report PDFs at https://www.fna.usda.gov/snap/waivers/state-options-report, the SNAP State Activity Reports (PDF, FY 2004-2023) at https://www.fna.usda.gov/pd/snap-state-activity-reports; the dashboard at https://www.fna.usda.gov/data-research/data-visualization/snap/state-options has no download button, so upload the PDF instead.

cache.why: The reports change once a year and the Program Data tables monthly; data/ is reused only within a run.

redistribution.why: Works of the U.S. Department of Agriculture, a federal agency: public domain (17 U.S.C. 105).

citation: U.S. Department of Agriculture, Food and Nutrition Administration, {dataset}, fna.usda.gov, retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Which State Options Report edition (as-of date)? Options change every year. Default: the latest, the 17th edition (Aug 2025, options in place Oct 1, 2024, FFY 2025).
SNAP issuance with or without emergency allotments (FY 2020-2023)? Default: report both, named separately (the State Activity Reports' total issuance includes them).
All 53 SNAP state agencies (50 states, DC, Guam, Virgin Islands) or the 50 states only? Default: all 53, the reports' own count.
Latest months are preliminary (initial for the newest) and revised later: report the status column with them. Default: use them, labeled.
Program year or federal fiscal year? FNA tables are federal fiscal years (October-September); school year SY 2024-25 is not FY 2025. Default: fiscal years, said so.
